title: Whether the army scarred Lester
summary: Lee rejects the view that the army permanently broke Lester, saying the effect lasted a year or two.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: After Lester got out of ... in-Red
People's account says he was never quite the same; it was like a permanent scar; the experience in the army. Is that the way you found him, too?

No, I don't really think that's true. No. I don't really think that's true. He wasn't a person that I found was really vindictive; he didn't carry hate around with him, and if he did -- if he did, his music wouldn't be the way it came out. I don't think that you can play so beautifully and then have all of that.
Well, I don't mean that I read anything that said he was full of hate, but, rather, that he had a broken spirit from having been mistreated.

Well, I think ... but I think that it lasted like a year or two, but I don't think a man can carry that type of thing for -- I don't think he was the type of person, I'm saying. Because I don't think it was of that magnitude, I don't -- I know it was rough on him, but it was rough on a lot of guys, you know. But I don't think it left on scars on Lester. I think that he was more intelligent than that.
